readme: ShaderLab backgrounds for Portfolio carousel cards. One entry per project id. `file` is the art-layer image, `preset` is the ShaderLab recipe it was rendered from, `shadowColor` is the image's average colour for projects.ts. See ~/Projects/ShaderLab/handoff/README.md.

backgrounds.palette: cream base, poppy orange and magenta masses, warm shadow
dark umber base, amber window light, leather
mauve base, pink light, plum shadow, pleats
grey base, crimson rise, navy shadow
grey base, dark blob, aperol light, pleats
